POSSIBLE_ACS: Possible acute coronary syndrome - combination of symptoms suggests potential heart attack or unstable angina
ABNORMAL_TROPONIN: Abnormal troponin level detected - may indicate heart muscle injury
TROPONIN_CHEST_PAIN: Elevated troponin with chest pain symptoms
CARDIAC_ARREST: Signs consistent with cardiac arrest - immediate life-threatening emergency
STROKE_SIGNS: Signs consistent with stroke (FAST criteria) - time-critical emergency
SEVERE_RESPIRATORY_DISTRESS: Severe difficulty breathing - potential respiratory or cardiac emergency
ANAPHYLAXIS: Signs of severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis) - life-threatening emergency
UNCONTROLLED_HEMORRHAGE: Severe uncontrolled bleeding - potential life-threatening blood loss
SYNCOPE_UNRESPONSIVE: Loss of consciousness or unresponsiveness - requires emergency evaluation
DIABETES_CARDIAC_RISK: Diabetes present - increases risk of cardiac events and warrants more urgent evaluation
ELDERLY_RISK: Age over 65 - increased risk for serious cardiac and vascular events
PRIOR_MI_RISK: History of prior heart attack - significantly increases risk of recurrent cardiac events
